_comment: Laptop overfit sanity run 2 of 3 (scripts/run_overfit_tests.cmd): the real 0.6B student on ~10 s of train audio (seeded subset of the kept reazon_small/emilia_yodas/galgame train rows; the ids are the `subset` events) for up to 100 epochs = 100 optimizer steps (step_audio_s >= the subset: one step per epoch), an eval after every epoch on ~10 s of the pooled gate eval sets (teacher-forced + greedy) and a probe on the whole train subset (teacher-forced + greedy on up to 10 s of it). Expect the probe KL and CER vs teacher to fall towards 0. Early stop as in overfit_1s.json: once the probe KL has not improved by max(0.001, 2 %) for 20 epochs in a row (never before epoch 10) the run goes to its end phase. Viability settings otherwise, SpecAugment off, warmup 10 steps (10 %), cooldown over the last 20 %, AdamW + fp32 masters offloaded to host memory with the fused CPU kernel (see overfit_1s.json for the measured CPU cost, ~2-2.5 s per step). Expected wall time: at most 100 x ~2.5-3 s steps (~5 min) + 100 evals x ~3-4 s (~6 min) + setup, smoke and the full states (8.6 GB each) after the smoke steps and every 10 min of loop time, the resume points scripts/supervise_distill.py relaunches from after a GPU fault (~6 min) = about 12-20 min, less when the early stop ends it. Every step ends an epoch, so every step has a full eval and the mini eval (eval.mini, every 200 steps) never fires. No GO/NO-GO: eval.gate false makes summary.json's verdict "N/A" with the numbers (a 1-10 s eval subset says nothing about the gate); every eval's headline (val / train CER, KL, top-1) is under summary/full/ in TensorBoard and on one console line. To stop it by hand: create runs/<run_id>/STOP.
